spatial_coverage.region_name: Africa (Malawi, Nigeria, Uganda, DRC, Cote d'Ivoire, Zambia)
spatial_coverage.coverage: Model-predicted medium voltage (MV) electrical distribution grid infrastructure for six African countries. The grid maps show distribution lines connecting high-voltage transmission infrastructure to consumer-serving low-voltage distribution networks.

data_description.temporal_unit: Static snapshot - model-predicted current grid infrastructure
data_description.records: Regional coverage for Malawi, Nigeria, Uganda, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Cote d'Ivoire, and Zambia with predicted medium voltage grid line locations
data_description.data_type_numeric: Binary or probability values indicating predicted presence of medium voltage grid infrastructure; inspect pixel values for grid presence likelihood.

raster_content.thematic_group: Global Utilities, Assets and Amenities Layers

data_description.important_note: This dataset was produced by Facebook (Meta) using a predictive model that combines multiple publicly-available datasets including nighttime satellite imagery, road networks, political boundaries, and other infrastructure data. The model predicts the location of existing medium voltage distribution grid infrastructure in regions where official grid maps are not publicly available. This is critical infrastructure data for electrification planning, energy access assessment, and development initiatives.
analytical_capabilities: Electricity grid coverage and accessibility mapping
Distance-to-grid calculations for renewable energy siting
Grid connectivity analysis for settlements and facilities
Development planning and infrastructure investment targeting

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Predicted medium voltage grid presence (binary or probability)
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Pixel values indicate predicted presence of medium voltage distribution lines. The dataset covers six African countries. Check metadata for country-specific layers and model confidence levels.
